#020 · Mouse Pokémon

Raticate

Normal

Kanto · Generation 1

Raticate is a Normal-type Mouse Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 18.5 kg. It evolves from Rattata. Its highest base stat is Speed (97), with a base stat total of 413.
